metadata.title: Minimal tubes of the sphere as the dimension grows: Volume and explosion of the mean exit time
metadata.abstract: The mean exit time of a Brownian motion from a tube around a closed, minimal embedded \(n\)-dimen\-sional submanifold of the \((n+m)\)-dimen\-sional sphere is studied, establishing two-sided bounds via radial transplant. In accordance with known results when \(n = 0\) or \(m = 1,\) the mean exit time goes to infinity as \(n \to \infty\) and to \(0\) as \(m \to \infty.\) Simultaneously, bounds for the volume of such tubes are derived and compared to Weyl's tube formula.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 高维球面 minimal tube 的体积与退出时间
analysis.workSummary: 对闭嵌入极小子流形的球面 tube 以径向 transplant 给 Brownian mean exit time 双侧界，并给 tube 体积界与 Weyl 公式比较。
analysis.breakthrough: 连接维数变化、tube 几何与随机退出时间。
analysis.limitations: 摘要的 n→∞ 发散与 m→∞ 趋零依其所述参数范围，不能无条件合并两种极限。
